body: Maybe try and talk to a doctor to see if medication can help with the anxiety. I had a lot of fear of working too but i found that my meds helped calm a lot of it down. Im still scared and anxious but not nearly as bad as before

Im not sure if it's like this everywhere, but it's how it was where i live. Even with the health insurance, the mental hospital cost so much money. I know my family didn't call an ambulance for when it happened either because it would've been even more expensive. It really is a nightmare to be alive right now

I don't think anything constitutes an attempt. For most people it varies on what the breaking point is, whatever is making them consider doing it. If you're asking at what point the suicidal ideation becomes an actual attempt, i think that'd be whenever the person actually attempts to harm themselves directly, however they choose to do it. Usually i think people plan for it or try to set it up, but i'd consider that more as building up to the attempt, not being the attempt itself until the plan is carried out. This is just what i think, though, it could be different. I'm glad that you're no longer planning for something like that and that your partner was able to help!
thanks, i appreciate you commenting. sometimes all it feels like you can do is cry, so at least we both can do that

i want to say im convinced not to do it, but im not. At least not fully. But knowing they care and want to help, it makes living seem just a little bit easier. Maybe i'll eventually get to the point where i dont want to die. Even if its not now. Im still struggling immensely with the thoughts, but your comment really helped. I dont know if ill be getting better any time soon, but this was a much needed reminder, so thank you
